Arthur shoots drawing bodyguard. Captain pushes a carrier into line and flees study. Kaze catches and redirects captain pistol upward; contact shot passes through his palm, away from Chris. Captain stabs his side; Kaze kills him with headbutt and captain own sword.

One chest is given to departing company for disarmament and noninterference, chosen by Daniel/Arthur with Chris information and Kaze assent. No army recruited or future loyalty purchased.

Chris switches to Billy on actual courtyard ground. Kaze brings upper chest down and uses Black Marrow to open two retained chests, showing gold and silver. Billy physically swallows both into storage.
Katarina takes orders; Kaze proposes drink, she leaves without accepting. No hookup, new partner, pregnancy, admission or scheduled return.
